en-US.name: Multisite TaHoma
en-US.summary: Multi-site Somfy TaHoma roller shutter control for homes with more than one TaHoma installation.
en-US.description:
Control your Somfy TaHoma roller shutters with Alexa — including homes with multiple TaHoma installations. Unlike the official Somfy skill, this skill supports several TaHoma boxes across different locations at the same time, exposing all roller shutters from all sites as a single unified device list.

Prerequisites

- One or more Somfy TaHoma Smart Home hubs (any generation supported by the Overkiz cloud platform)
- An active Somfy account with at least one paired roller shutter device
- The Alexa app on iOS or Android

Getting started

1. Enable this skill in the Alexa app and tap Link Account.
2. Enter your Somfy account email and password on the login page.
3. After linking, say "Alexa, discover devices" or use Devices → + → Add Device in the Alexa app.
4. Your roller shutters will appear named by installation and room (for example, "Home - Balcony shutter", "Spain - Balcony shutter").

Features

- Open and close roller shutters by voice: "Alexa, open the balcony shutter"
- Set a precise opening level: "Alexa, set the balcony shutter to 50 percent"
- Adjust relative to current position: "Alexa, raise the balcony shutter by 20 percent"
- Check current state: "Alexa, what is the balcony shutter set to?"
- Full support for Alexa routines and schedules
- All TaHoma installations on your account are discovered automatically

Limitations

- Only roller shutter devices are supported. Other TaHoma device types (lights, heating, gates) are not exposed.
- Requires an active internet connection and access to the Somfy cloud.
- This is an unofficial, community-developed skill and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Somfy, Overkiz, or Amazon.
examplePhrases: Alexa, set the balcony shutter to fifty percent.

nl-NL.name: Multisite TaHoma
nl-NL.summary: Bedien Somfy TaHoma rolluiken en zonwering op meerdere locaties.
nl-NL.description: Breidt de officiële TaHoma-skill uit met ondersteuning voor meerdere Somfy-installaties (bijv. thuis en vakantiewoning). Ontdek en bedien alle rolluiken en zonwering per kamer op al uw locaties. Koppel uw Somfy-account via accountkoppeling en zeg 'Alexa, ontdek apparaten' om alle rolluiken van al uw TaHoma-installaties te importeren.
examplePhrases: Alexa, zet het balkonrolluik op vijftig procent.
